settings.no_backend:
No reviewer configured. Choose one in your environment (e.g. the "env" block of ~/.claude/settings.json):
  ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BACKEND=codex      uses your Codex login (codex CLI)
  ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BACKEND=opencode   uses a provider you configured in opencode; also set ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_MODEL=<provider>/<model>
  ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BACKEND=endpoint   an OpenAI-compatible URL; also set ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_MODEL, ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_URL and ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN_FILE (a chmod 600 file)
Nothing was sent anywhere.
settings.endpoint_model: ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_MODEL must name the endpoint's model (got {value!r}).
settings.no_token: The endpoint needs ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN_FILE (a chmod 600 file) or ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN.
settings.token_both: Set ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN or ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN_FILE, not both.
settings.token_file_unreadable: Cannot read the file named by {var}: {error}.
settings.token_file_not_regular: The token file {path} is not a regular file.
settings.token_file_mode: The token file {path} is readable by others ({mode}); run chmod 600 on it.
settings.token_empty: The endpoint token is empty or contains whitespace.
settings.token_file_not_absolute: {var} must be an absolute path to a file (a leading ~ is accepted). Put the token itself in ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENDPOINT_TOKEN, not here.
settings.token_file_too_big: The token file is larger than {limit} bytes.
settings.token_file_not_text: The token file is not valid UTF-8 text.
review.title: # Plan review — round {n} — {namespace}
review.not_in_git: {path} must be inside a git repository.
review.changed_while_starting: {path} changed while the round was starting; run it again
review.gate_unavailable: plan-gate not reachable ({error}). Is plan-gate ≥ 0.2.0 installed and has it run in this session? Nothing was sent anywhere.
review.bad_backend: The {backend} backend cannot be used: {problem}. Nothing was sent anywhere.
review.model_ignored: {backend} does not take a model choice; ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_MODEL={model} was ignored and is not declared
review.repairing: the reviewer's JSON is unusable ({error}); asking for ONE repair in the same session
review.gate_rerun_failed: The verdict was recorded, but plan-gate could not re-run its checks ({error}); it will on the next edit of the plan or on `plan_gate.py run-checks`.
review.state_failed: NO VERDICT: the review state folder {folder} cannot be read or written ({error}). No verdict changed.
review.bad_timeout: --timeout must be a positive number of seconds (got {value!r}).
review.round_running: Another round of {path} is running right now (same backend). Wait for it to finish, then run this one again. Nothing was sent anywhere.
check.no_hash: adversarial-review: the gate did not pass PLAN_GATE_CONTENT_HASH (plan-gate older than 0.2.0?). Update plan-gate.
check.state_unreadable: adversarial-review: the review state cannot be read ({error}) in {folder}. Run the review again.
check.no_review:
adversarial-review: no review of THIS content yet. Run the skill /review-plan, or:
  {command}
check.rejected:
adversarial-review: round {n} REJECTED with {blockers} blocker(s); read {md}, fix the PLAN, then review again:
  {command}
check.ceiling:
adversarial-review: {n} rounds and still rejected ({md}). This is a decision for the person who decides, not a detail: fix the plan with them, or release with
  {release} --reason "…" --despite-check adversarial-review="<why>"
opencode.missing:
`opencode` is not installed, and the reviewer runs inside it.
  curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
  (or `snap install opencode`, if you prefer)
opencode.too_old:
opencode {found} is too old; the config this review generates needs {minimum} or newer. The same installer upgrades it:
  curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
  (or `snap install opencode`, if you prefer)
